comments.body:
Given how competitive the housing market is, taking the Woko room might be the safest choice if you need a place to live right away and being close to ETH Höng is important to you. 

But if you're ready to take a chance on possibly better accommodations, you could wait for the Living Science option, even though you don't know when or if it will be available.
